summary: Iteration 9 frontend-only review + light backend regression. All requested flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Backend regression on complete-level: POST /api/players/{id}/complete-level with {level:1, dish_id:'soft_pretzel', coins_earned:600, bells_earned:15, completed:true, stars:3} correctly awarded +600 coins, +15 bells, stored stars={'1':3}, incremented current_level 1->2, unlocked 'happy_cakes'; player CRUD + daily-reward endpoints unchanged. Frontend: (1) Onboarding via username-input + create-player-button lands on home-screen. (2) gallery-button on home routes to /gallery -> all 4 badges render (badge-love, badge-bell, badge-cityhall, badge-rocky) with 0/4 count for a fresh player (levelsBeaten=0), consistent with locked state; gallery-back returns to home. (3) Level-1 Soft Pretzel game screen: recipe rail shows ONLY the 5 base-recipe chips (recipe-dough, recipe-salt, recipe-cheese_sauce, recipe-mustard, recipe-pizza_sauce); non-base items chocolate_sauce/spicy/american/cinnamon_sauce absent. Board tiles (BOARD_SIZE=7, 49 cells) render exactly {salt 🧂, cheese_sauce 🧀, mustard 🟨, pizza_sauce 🍅, dough=SoftPretzel } with 11 dough tiles carrying an (SoftPretzel photo) — no chocolate/spicy/cinnamon tiles present. (4) /serve loads (via game route or direct URL) and tray-* buttons list all 8 serveOptions(dish) = [salt, cheese_sauce, mustard, pizza_sauce, spicy, cinnamon_sauce, chocolate_sauce, american]; tray-dough is intentionally absent (CARRIERS filter in dishes.ts). tray-cinnamon_sauce renders the CinnamonSticks SVG (svg element present, label 'Cinnamon') rather than an emoji. (5) customer-mood is visible next to the avatar with initial 😀 (patience>0.6). (6) Executing 5 perfect serves surfaces the milestone-cheer overlay ('5 of 10 served! Keep it up!') exactly at the halfway mark, then disappears after ~1.5s. (7) Completing all 10 customers with correct orders routes to /cooking-result with completed=1, stars-row rendering three gold stars, and perfect-bonus banner visible ('🏆 PERFECT RUN! +200 🪙 · Served all 10 with no misses'), NEXT UP shows 🧁 Happy Cakes; coins-earned surface shows +3815 total (base rewards + streak bonuses + client-side +200 perfect bonus). SparkleBurst triggers per perfect serve. No React Native red screen, no PAGEERROR, no critical console errors. Deprecated packages detected: none in reviewed files. SafeAreaView issues detected: none — screens correctly use useSafeAreaInsets from react-native-safe-area-context.
critical_code_review_comments: game.tsx buildPalette(baseKeys) correctly restricts the match-3 board palette to Object.keys(dish.base_recipe) only — the serving-phase toppings (spicy/chocolate_sauce/american/cinnamon_sauce for pretzel) never appear as board tiles. Verified live on level 1.

dishes.ts serveOptions(dish) = dedupe(base_recipe keys ∪ topping_options) minus CARRIERS(dough/roll/cup). For Soft Pretzel returns exactly [salt, cheese_sauce, mustard, pizza_sauce, spicy, cinnamon_sauce, chocolate_sauce, american]; matches the tray order observed and excludes dough as required.

serve.tsx toppings fallback: `Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0 ? parsed : serveOptions(dish)` — protects the tray from ever showing an empty grid even if params.toppings is missing or malformed. Good defensive coding.

serve.tsx patienceMs = max(7000, 15000 - (level-1)*1100) scales patience down with level — customers get 15s at L1, 13.9s at L2, 7s floor at L8+. Mood emoji thresholds 0.6/0.3 are consistent with the visual patience bar color breakpoints (0.5/0.25), which is a minor cosmetic mismatch (mood turns 😐 slightly before the bar turns yellow) but likely intentional and not a defect.

serve.tsx halfway milestone uses Math.ceil(total/2) with newServed=servedCount+(ok?1:0); confirmed to fire exactly on the 5th perfect serve for a 10-customer level and never on a miss. Cleanup via setTimeout(1500) also verified.

serve.tsx finishLevel: perfectRun = served >= total AND missedRef.current === 0; perfectBonus = total*20 (=200 for 10). Bonus is added to finalCoins on both the client-side coins param AND the backend POST body coins_earned — backend regression confirmed the persisted award matches.
cooking-result.tsx renders perfect-bonus banner ONLY when win && perfectBonusCoins > 0 — no false positives on partial completions.

gallery.tsx computes levelsBeaten = max(0, current_level-1) and gates via >= levelsNeeded (1/2/4/6). A fresh player (current_level=1) correctly shows 0/4 unlocked. All 4 testIDs (badge-love, badge-bell, badge-cityhall, badge-rocky) present.
index.tsx gallery-button uses router.push('/gallery') — matches file-based route in app/gallery.tsx.

IngredientIcon.tsx does the id-based override (dough -> SoftPretzel <Image>, cinnamon_sauce -> CinnamonSticks <Svg>) before falling back to emoji <Text>; used consistently across game recipe chips, board tiles, ticket rows, plate chips, tray items. Great for a unified look.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 requested flows verified — onboarding, base-only board, transition to serve, full tray incl. cinnamon SVG, mood emoji, halfway milestone-cheer, perfect-bonus banner + stars-row on cooking-result, /gallery 4 badges with lock state, home gallery-button navigation)
